headline: Abbey Bank Retains A3 Short-Term Credit Rating on Strong Liquidity
summary: Abbey Bank Plc retained its A3 short-term and BBB- long-term credit ratings with a stable outlook from Agusto & Co., reflecting improved capitalisation and strong liquidity.
why: Credit ratings from local agencies determine borrowing costs and funding access for Nigerian mortgage and commercial lenders in domestic debt markets.

impacts.name: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc
impacts.why: Rating affirmation confirms creditworthiness and strong liquidity, stabilizing funding access.
